name: Suffolk city, VA
findings: Suffolk city has 314 nonprofit organizations. 123 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 99 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Suffolk city has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 28 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 14 in similar places of this size.
